review: Vault consistency check (PR 1): the background check reads the save progress (Outbox + ledger) before and after the READ ONLY scan, keeps saving / unsettled results unrecorded with a bounded automatic re-check, shows the classified report, and the normal 修復する no longer starts the 2026-10-03 narrow repair (it only resumes an interrupted one; otherwise only records the current version can fix go through the existing Recovery Apply). Exact +/- lines of ChatScreen.tsx; no Memory / Retrieval / Timeline / Synthesis / prompt change. PR 3 (auto repair): handleUserRepair runs runProductionVaultAutoRepair (backup, re-verification right before, exclusive section, re-check) for the report's repairTargets; the outcome is kept (cleared on a Vault switch) and passed to Settings.
